mentions.name: Captain Zero
mentions.description: A side project that makes it easy to unsubscribe from marketing email lists: users forward the marketing email to a dedicated unsubscribe address, and the service handles the rest without requiring access to the user's inbox.
mentions.problem: Unsubscribing from marketing email lists is a hassle, and existing solutions typically require granting access to your inbox.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Side project to easily unsubscribe from marketing lists. Just forward the email to the unsubscribe address. No inbox access required.

https://captainzero.ai
